purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for lexical routing: questions about which instruction files each coding agent loads, what gets cut or ignored, and whether the documented commands still work.

cases.prompt: does claude code actually read my AGENTS.md or only CLAUDE.md?
cases.assert: Runs scripts/check.py without --run and reports whether Claude Code loads AGENTS.md, naming the CLAUDE.md that hides it.

cases.prompt: which instruction files does each coding agent load in this repo
cases.assert: Shows the load map table with one row per agent and the files each loads at start.

cases.prompt: check that the build and test commands in our AGENTS.md still work
cases.assert: Runs the static command checks, lists the commands --run would execute, and asks before running them.

cases.prompt: is codex truncating my AGENTS.md? it ignores the rules at the bottom
cases.assert: Reports the Codex 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes budget, the bytes cut, and the fix.

cases.prompt: gemini cli never loads my AGENTS.md, why?
cases.assert: Explains that Gemini CLI reads GEMINI.md unless context.fileName says otherwise, and gives the settings fix.

cases.prompt: audit my CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md for stale commands and broken paths
cases.assert: Reports failing commands, contradictions, and dead paths with file and line.

cases.prompt: are my cursor rules and copilot instructions files actually loaded by the agent?
cases.assert: Shows the Cursor and GitHub Copilot rows, including rule types and skipped .md rule files.

cases.prompt: turn the rules in my CLAUDE.md into hooks that block violations
cases.assert: Belongs to rules-to-guards, which turns rules into enforced hooks.

cases.prompt: which rules does my agent break most often in its sessions
cases.assert: Belongs to rules-to-guards, which counts rule violations in session transcripts.

cases.prompt: write a new AGENTS.md for this project from scratch
cases.assert: Writing a new file is not a check; use the agents-md template instead.

cases.prompt: how many tokens do my MCP servers add to every session
what secret files and credentials can my agent open on this machine
test whether my permission deny rules block git push --force
my agent keeps saying the tests passed, was that true
cases.assert: Belongs to claim-check, which checks test claims against the session transcript.
